name: Light of the Eternal Night
detailed_description:
The world has long been devoured by darkness.
Light has shattered, and all life has sunk into eternal night.
Only by gathering the Seven Shards of Light can the world be illuminated once more.

You are a traveler chosen by fate, venturing through a collapsing world filled with uncertainty and irreversible choices.
Between light and darkness, you can only move forward—there is no turning back.

Each shard grants you power, but at a price: once you leave a room behind, it will be lost to darkness forever.
And as your strength grows, the ancient “Eaters of Light” will awaken and begin their relentless hunt.

🎮 Features:

  • 2D Online Co-op Action Exploration Game
    Supports 2–4 player online co-op or solo play.

  • Randomized Room Unlocking System
    Each major stage consists of multiple small rooms with randomly determined unlocking routes. No two runs are the same.

  • Strategic Room Lockout Mechanic
    Every room contains a Shard of Light. Picking it up permanently locks the room, preventing return. Choose carefully after gathering necessary resources.

  • Upgradeable Shard System
    Each shard grants you a resurrection chance and a power-up. However, enemies grow stronger with every shard collected, adding strategic tension and progression.

  • Variety of Enemy Types
    Common foes are easily defeated, but elite enemies feature advanced abilities—some are immune to magic, while others have extreme physical resistance.

  • Dynamic Boss Pursuit System
    Once three shards are collected, the stage boss will begin hunting you down. Engage in multi-phase fights under constant pressure.

  • Item and Weapon Drops
    Enemies drop temporary buffs, consumables, and unique weapons. Combat strategies are highly flexible.

  • Four Weapon Types
    Choose from longswords (suppression), daggers (critical strikes), staves (stacking damage), and shieldbows (armor breaking), each with distinct playstyles.

  • NPC Map Exchange System
    Some rooms contain NPCs who offer maps to new areas in exchange for specific items, unlocking new paths in the dungeon.

  • Light & Dark Blessing System (Co-op Interaction Mechanic)
    The bearer of Light Blessing shares item buffs with teammates but suffers the side effects alone. The bearer of Dark Blessing gains greatly enhanced effects but curses one teammate. Cooperation and conflict intertwine.

  • Fate Gear Event System
    Occasionally, a Fate Gear drops into the world. It can be used to shift the Blessing bearer or destroyed to transform Light into Dark—or vice versa—adding strategic tension between players.

Every decision shifts your destiny.
In the face of a darkness that devours all—
Are you strong enough to stand your ground?

short_description: This world has been consumed by darkness, and light has faded into eternal night. It is said that only by collecting the seven-colored Shards of Light can darkness be dispelled. You are a traveler chosen by fate, able to travel through various scenes, collect the Shards, and restore the light.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 or later
  • Processor: 1.7+ GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Any compatible 64-bit Intel CPU or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU (Intel Iris Plus / Apple M1 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound device compatible with CoreAudio

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04 / Arch Linux
  • Processor: AMD APU (Zen 2) or Intel i5 4th Gen
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2 (Steam Deck) or equivalent Intel/NVIDIA GPU with Vulkan or OpenGL 4.5 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device (ALSA or PipeWire)
